issues.description: Cell 1 is labeled as a 3D control, but its perovskite formula and ion composition are empty. The absorber layer name “3D Me3SPbI3” also appears inconsistent with the paper’s distinction between the 3D control, the 1D/3D device, and pure 1D Me3SPbI3.
issues.suggested_value: Identify the actual 3D control composition from the methods/supporting information.
issues.source_text: The paper separately reports a pure 1D Me3SPbI3 device and a 1D/3D device; the 3D control reaches 20.10%.
